title: Member Services Policy: Disconnection Courtesy in PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Meter Error Refunds
content:
**Section 1.** A PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) meter error refund carries a disconnection courtesy set by the low-balance disconnections of the enrollment in the refund window, counted by the disconnected alerts on the enrollment's PrePay notifications.

**Section 2.** Where the enrollment was disconnected for low balance at least as many times as the tier's counseling referral count in the refund window, the disconnection courtesy is 10.00; where it was disconnected for low balance at least twice but fewer times in the refund window, it is 5.00; with fewer disconnections it stays at zero.

**Section 3.** The counseling referral count is 4 disconnections on PrePay Power Residential, PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25, PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40, PrePay Power Seasonal and PrePay Power Outbuilding, and 3 on PrePay Power Small Commercial.

| Disconnections for low balance in the refund window | Small Commercial | Every other tier |
|---|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 2 | 5.00 | 5.00 |
| 3 | 10.00 | 5.00 |
| 4 or more | 10.00 | 10.00 |

**Section 4.** The refund window for this count is the same refund window over which the refund's charge lines are taken; a disconnection whose alert falls outside it does not count.
